summary: Core AI Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing its second quarter 2026 financial results. The release reports a 56% year-over-year revenue increase to $22.4 million and a significant improvement in gross margin. This is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is disclosed. The filing is solely for informational purposes and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
